// diagnostic

E1333

A typed environment fact is invalid or unusable

What

A typed environment fact is invalid or unusable

Why

Language packs use one catalog with explicit host, platform, license, and required-tool facts. Dotenv paths stay inside the project, expert allowlists make secret handling explicit, and Git hook paths stay inside the project and name an existing directory.

Fix

Fix the language selection/catalog fact, use a project-relative file and `Dotenv{ file, allow, secrets }` with valid variable names, or create an in-project directory for `git_hooks_path`.
